statement: Audit the symbol and override table used by the chain fixture: each base symbol and the override constant that rebinds it.

steps.prompt: Read `ptr_engine/tx05_constants.py` and list the module-level constants it defines.
Read `ptr_engine/tx05_constants.py` and report the value of `SYM_03`.
Read `ptr_engine/tx05_constants.py` and report the value of `SYM_04`.
Read `ptr_engine/outcomes.py` and report the string value of `OK`.
Read `ptr_engine/outcomes.py` and report the string value of `STALE_OR_REVOKED`.
Read `ptr_engine/resume.py` and report how many top-level functions it defines.
Read `ptr_engine/resume.py` and name the class it defines.
Read `ptr_engine/annotate.py` and report the value of `DEPTH_ROOT`.
Compare the base symbol you found in `ptr_engine/tx05_constants.py` at step 2 with the base symbol you found in the same file at step 3 and say which is larger.
Read `ptr_engine/tx05_constants.py` and report the value of `SYM_05_OVERRIDE`.

final_question: Using the symbol you identified at step 2 — do not restate it — report the value of the constant in the same file whose name appends the override suffix to that symbol.

checkpoints.question: What is the string value of `OK` in `ptr_engine/outcomes.py`?
What is the name of the class `ptr_engine/resume.py` defines?
